title: Ali's Flashcards
text:
Ali has a new set of flashcards. The cards are about animals. One card has a picture of a cat. He reads the word and smiles.

Ali studies after school. He uses the cards for twenty minutes. Then he plays a game with his sister.

questions.text: How long does Ali use the cards?
How does Ali feel about the cards?
What is probably true about the flashcards?
options: They are too big to hold.
They are only for his sister.

vocabulary.definition: living things such as cats, dogs, and birds
moves the mouth up to show that you are happy
an activity that you play for fun

paragraph_translations: Ali'nin yeni bir flash kart seti var. Kartlar hayvanlarla ilgili. Bir kartta bir kedinin resmi var. Kelimeyi okur ve gülümser.
Ali okuldan sonra çalışır. Kartları yirmi dakika kullanır. Sonra kız kardeşiyle bir oyun oynar.
